title: TorchDCM: A Unified PyTorch-Native Package for Discrete Choice Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.19231v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Estimating large and simulation-intensive discrete choice models (DCMs) requires repeated evaluation of utilities, probabilities, derivatives, and simulated likelihoods over many observations, alternatives, and draws. Existing DCM software provides mature econometric workflows, while recent GPU-oriented tools accelerate selected models, leaving a gap between econometric coverage and scalable differentiable computation. We introduce TorchDCM, an open Python package for discrete choice modeling that compiles choice data and model specifications into a unified PyTorch-native likelihood engine for estimation, inference, prediction, and structured reporting on CPU or CUDA devices. The package covers the principal econometric functionality available across Biogeme and Apollo, including multinomial, nested, mixed, ordered, latent-variable, and panel likelihoods. translated_title: TorchDCM：一个统一的PyTorch原生离散选择建模包
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.19231v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：估计大规模且模拟密集的离散选择模型（DCMs）需要在众多观测值、备选项和抽样次数上重复评估效用、概率、导数以及模拟似然。现有DCM软件提供了成熟的经济计量工作流程，而近期的GPU导向工具加速了特定模型，留下了经济计量覆盖范围与可扩展微分计算之间的空白。我们引入了TorchDCM，一个开源的Python离散选择建模包，它将选择数据和模型规范编译成一个统一的PyTorch原生似然引擎，用于在CPU或CUDA设备上进行估计、推断、预测和结构化报告。该包涵盖了Biogeme和Apollo中可用的主要经济计量功能，包括多项、嵌套、混合、有序、潜变量和面板似然。它还支持不整齐的选择集、约束参数和协方差估计。
tldr: TorchDCM是一个PyTorch原生的统一包，通过编译选择数据和模型规范到高效似然引擎，填补了离散选择模型在经济计量覆盖与可扩展GPU计算之间的空白。
en_tdlr: TorchDCM is a unified PyTorch-native package that bridges the gap between econometric coverage and scalable differentiable computation in discrete choice modeling by compiling choice data and model specifications into an efficient likelihood engine.
